svg.title: PMF Sub-goal #4 Layered View — WHO Models

a.title: Pooling of funds: Allocate pooled health funds equitably across programmes, regions and populations to support redistributive capacity and to achieve financial protection (Goal)

text.tspan: Pooling of funds: Allocate pooled health funds
equitably across programmes, regions and populations…

a.title: Risk equalization / allocation formulas defined and applied. (Outcome)
Population-based allocation models published and periodically reviewed. (Outcome)
Reduced inequities in per-capita allocations across regions/programmes. (Outcome)
Scheme-level fund management (ability to manage pooled resources within coverage schemes). (Capability)
Risk assessment (ability to assess population-level health and cost risk). (Capability)
Risk allocation / risk equalization (ability to define and apply allocation formulas). (Capability)
Health expenditure forecasting (ability to model expected costs and service use at system level). (Capability)
Risk assessment and stratification algorithms (Application Service)
Allocation and risk equalisation calculations (Application Service)
Risk equalisation / allocation engine (rule-based or ML-assisted, depending on maturity) (Application Component)
Financial (e.g. insurance) management system (see Open HIE)/ data warehouse (Application Component)
